simulation_visible: 0x24 last_handle (scripts store it and pass it back to kill/set calls)
presentation_only: 0x20 owner id (key into the global effect list)
simulation_vs_presentation.note: is_exist_effect (slot +0x188) reads no module field: it checks the global effect pool (handle >> 24 selects a 0x300-byte entry whose +0x4 must equal the handle), so it is a read of live presentation state by game logic. A port that drops effects must still answer is_exist_effect / is_end_common / is_exist_common consistently (e.g. track handle lifetimes) for scripts that branch on them; all other fields can be stubbed without changing the simulation.

notes: Field names without an export are inferred from slot behaviour. Exports with null slots dispatch: req +0x68, set_visible +0x190 (per handle: writes entry +0x2D4 in the global pool, no module field), set_visible_kind +0x198, set_whole +0x1A8, set_whole_attr +0x1B8, set_billboard +0x328, set_disable_system_slow +0x350, set_sync_visibility +0x288, set_sync_scale +0x298, sync_visibility +0x408. Every 'set on live effects' slot walks the global effect list at [0x7105334af8] matching entry+0x8 against +0x20 | category bit.
